title: Platform admin and its neighbours
caption: The console is a backend-for-frontend: the browser only talks to the Next.js server, which calls the platform API's /v1/admin surface on loopback. Everything else happens behind the API.

nodes.label: Platform admin (browser)
nodes.detail: Velexis staff with `is_platform_admin = true` and MFA. Holds only `__Host-vxa_*` cookies (HttpOnly), never a token in JavaScript.

nodes.label: Caddy admin.platform.example.com
nodes.detail: TLS, HSTS, WAF (DetectionOnly), `/health/*` answers 404 from outside, optional `@outside_staff` IP allow-list (commented). Proxies to 127.0.0.1:3001.

nodes.label: Platform admin (Next.js :3001)
nodes.detail: Server components and server actions in `platform/admin/src/app`; middleware refreshes the session and sets the CSP nonce.

nodes.label: Portal (:3000)
nodes.detail: Linked only: an admin enables MFA at `/account/security` and resets the password at `/forgot-password` (same account).

nodes.label: Platform API (:3100)
nodes.detail: 68 `admin*` operations (`x-scope: platform_admin`); re-reads `is_platform_admin` on every call; writes one `platform_audit_log` row per change.

nodes.label: Platform worker
nodes.detail: Sends e-mails from `email_outbox`, verifies Amadeus accounts, runs domain checks, Stripe events, settlements, and answers tenant events.

nodes.label: OTA worker
nodes.detail: Consumes `ota-tenant-ops` (provision, migrate, suspend, resume housekeeping) and answers on `platform-tenant-events`.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL (platform schema)
nodes.detail: `platform.*` tables only; the admin never reaches a tenant schema.

nodes.label: BullMQ (prefix vx)
nodes.detail: Platform queues `platform-*` (retry from the console) and OTA queues `ota-*` (view only).

nodes.label: SMTP (Mailpit :8025 in dev)
nodes.detail: Owner e-mails after suspend, resume, office assignment, payout review, settlement paid, domain removal, MFA reset.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.detail: Price checks, subscription resync and event re-fetch (M5, behind feature switches).

nodes.label: Amadeus (stub :4900 in dev)
nodes.detail: Token request that verifies the Velexis Amadeus account.
